ValidationRule.description: Requires Loss Reason Notes when an Opportunity moves to Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), ISBLANK(Loss_Reason_Notes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter Loss Reason Notes before closing the Opportunity as lost.
